# CodeAdventure Level 4 - Python 3 🐍
import sys

w, h = [int(i) for i in input().split()]
n = int(input())
x0, y0 = [int(i) for i in input().split()]

min_x, max_x = 0, w - 1
min_y, max_y = 0, h - 1

while True:
    bomb_dir = input()
    if 'U' in bomb_dir: max_y = y0 - 1
    if 'D' in bomb_dir: min_y = y0 + 1
    if 'L' in bomb_dir: max_x = x0 - 1
    if 'R' in bomb_dir: min_x = x0 + 1
    
    x0 = (min_x + max_x) // 2
    y0 = (min_y + max_y) // 2
    print(f"{x0} {y0}")

templates.python:
# CodeAdventure Level 6 - Python 3 🐍 (OOPs & Class Inheritance / Heritage)
import sys

# 1. Parent Class (Base Blueprint)
class BaseMecha:
    def __init__(self, name, hp, attack_power):
        self.name = name
        self.hp = hp
        self.attack_power = attack_power

    def attack(self, target):
        return f"BaseMecha '{self.name}' attacks {target} for {self.attack_power} damage!"

# 2. Child Class (Inheritance / Heritage)
class HeavyMecha(BaseMecha):
    def __init__(self, name, hp, attack_power, shield_power):
        # Inherit parent attributes using super()
        super().__init__(name, hp, attack_power)
        self.shield_power = shield_power  # Child attribute

    # Override attack method
    def attack(self, target):
        return f"HeavyMecha '{self.name}' (HP:{self.hp}, Shield:{self.shield_power}) attacks {target} for {self.attack_power} damage!"

# 3. Instantiate Hero Object & Execute Method
hero = HeavyMecha("Titan-X", 120, 85, 40)
boss = input()  # Enemy Boss Name
print(hero.attack(boss))

<?php
// CodeAdventure Level 6 - PHP 🐘 (OOPs & Class Inheritance)
class BaseMecha {
    public $name; public $hp; public $attackPower;
    public function __construct($name, $hp, $attackPower) {
        $this->name = $name; $this->hp = $hp; $this->attackPower = $attackPower;
    }
}

class HeavyMecha extends BaseMecha {
    public $shieldPower;
    public function __construct($name, $hp, $attackPower, $shieldPower) {
        parent::__construct($name, $hp, $attackPower);
        $this->shieldPower = $shieldPower;
    }

        return "HeavyMecha '{$this->name}' (HP:{$this->hp}, Shield:{$this->shieldPower}) attacks {$target} for {$this.attackPower} damage!";
    }
}

# CodeAdventure Level 7 - Ruby 💎 (Proc / Method Decorators)
def power_buff(fn)
    lambda do |target, damage|
        "BUFFED [2x DAMAGE + SHIELD] #{fn.call(target, damage * 2)}"
    end
end

end

templates.php:
<?php
// CodeAdventure Level 7 - PHP 🐘 (Higher-Order Closure Decorator)
function powerBuff($fn) {
    return function($target, $damage) use ($fn) {
        $buffed = $damage * 2;
        return "BUFFED [2x DAMAGE + SHIELD] " . $fn($target, $buffed);
    };
}

$fireLaser = function($target, $damage) {
    return "Fired Laser at {$target} for {$damage} damage!";
};

$fireLaser = powerBuff($fireLaser);

levels.funnyHint: Woof! SENSE perceives state -> THINK picks tool (REPAIR/RELOAD/FIRE) -> ACT executes tool! Let the AI Agent think for itself! 🐶

templates.ruby:
# CodeAdventure Level 8 - Ruby 💎 (Autonomous AI Agent Loop)
class CyberAIAgent
    def sense(health, ammo, enemy)
        { health: health, ammo: ammo, enemy: enemy }
    end
    def think(state)
        return "REPAIR_SHIELD" if state[:health] < 30
        return "RELOAD_AMMO" if state[:ammo] == 0
        "FIRE_WEAPON"
    end
    def act(action, state)
        return "ACTION [REPAIR_SHIELD] - Restored 50 HP!" if action == "REPAIR_SHIELD"
        return "ACTION [RELOAD_AMMO] - Ammo Refilled!" if action == "RELOAD_AMMO"
        "ACTION [FIRE_WEAPON] - #{state[:enemy]} BLASTED!"
    end
end

agent = CyberAIAgent.new
health = gets.to_i
ammo = gets.to_i
enemy = gets.chomp

state = agent.sense(health, ammo, enemy)
action = agent.think(state)
puts agent.act(action, state)
templates.php:
<?php
// CodeAdventure Level 8 - PHP 🐘 (Autonomous AI Agent Loop)
class CyberAIAgent {
    public function sense($health, $ammo, $enemy) {
        return ["health" => $health, "ammo" => $ammo, "enemy" => $enemy];
    }
    public function think($state) {
        if ($state["health"] < 30) return "REPAIR_SHIELD";
        if ($state["ammo"] == 0) return "RELOAD_AMMO";
        return "FIRE_WEAPON";
    }
    public function act($action, $state) {
        if ($action === "REPAIR_SHIELD") return "ACTION [REPAIR_SHIELD] - Restored 50 HP!";
        if ($action === "RELOAD_AMMO") return "ACTION [RELOAD_AMMO] - Ammo Refilled!";
        return "ACTION [FIRE_WEAPON] - " . $state["enemy"] . " BLASTED!";
    }
}

$agent = new CyberAIAgent();
$health = (int)trim(fgets(STDIN));
$ammo = (int)trim(fgets(STDIN));
$enemy = trim(fgets(STDIN));

$state = $agent->sense($health, $ammo, $enemy);
$action = $agent->think($state);
echo $agent->act($action, $state) . "\n";
